name: the-stage-lab
description: The visual delivery engine for sessions and stage talks, with a permanent 13-character Pixar-style cast (generated once on Higgsfield, then only ever edited into new scenes at ~2 credits each — kids, adults, elders, a dog and a cat, correctly cast per role) plus a free soft-3D tier for diagrams and recaps. Offline single-file HTML outputs. Four skills: story-slides turns any story into a character-driven slide deck; live-visual builds teaching diagrams element-by-element live; stage-arc structures the talk on the what-is/what-could-be sparkline with a cast-aware shot list; session-recap turns the delivered session into one visual-summary canvas. Built on researched foundations: beat-to-shot-to-light grammar, caption laws, MIT/CC0 asset systems. Now also includes the Model Lab (core-model, value-pyramid, mountain, three-roads: guided interviews, self-drawing worksheets, 7-minute draw-along scripts, geometry grammar catalogue) and gsap-blueprint-deck (cinematic horizontally-scrolling GSAP workshop decks as single offline HTML files).
